game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the seed vault.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 24. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Finish both paths at their separate output depots. Deliver exactly 12 components (6 upper, 6 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 12.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Misty Bog'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the seed vault by solving code steps involving pattern_rows that move the forest ranger forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the seed vault first, or lives reach 0.

Branch contracts: A: 6 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_upper; B: 6 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_lower. Power the junctions and production machines. A blocked branch waits without losing items.
